card.name: Lofty ideals and peak achievement words
card.fires_on: Elevated, abstract words about perfection, high points or ideals in essay-style prose on culture, philosophy and religion. Examples are high, perfect, immutable, aesthetic, peak, Golden Age and ideal.

modes.label: Peaks and golden ages
modes.description: Words for a high point or flourishing period in history or the arts.
modes.example: The music started around the beginning of the 20th century and it seems to have reached a creative<< peak>> in the 1920s

modes.label: Perfection and ideal qualities
modes.description: Abstract qualities in lists or philosophical talk, such as perfect, immutable, aesthetic or ideal.
modes.example: the most beautiful,<< perfect>>, simple, and potentially productive human institution

card.writes: Weak, mixed output effect, with a slight lean toward abstract nouns of admiration or quality such as intelligence and youth.
card.plain: It lights up on grand, idealized words like perfect, peak or golden age in essays about culture and philosophy.
